rites.name: Osiashora
rites.text: Osiashora is the concept of the first sounding in Elamirla, the note that drew the scattered roots of the world together during the Singing. It is remembered less as a being than as a resonance that still hums beneath the stones of the realm.

rites.name: Nirnum
rites.text: Nirnum is the concept of a tone held between the first roots of Elamirla, a sounding that binds loose matter into the first shapes of the world during the Singing. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds, Nirnum was the note that rang each fracture back into order.

rites.name: Amestor
rites.text: Amestor is a concept in Elamirla that governs how the Three Futures branch and are shelved in the Library, so that each possible ending can be read before it is chosen. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old bonds between peoples, Amestor was invoked to decide which futures would be kept and which would be sealed away.
